name: 3D City Run 2
summary: 3D City Run 2 offers an electrifying escape into a post-apocalyptic urban landscape, where survival hinges on rapid reflexes and strategic weapon upgrades. Step into the shoes of Leon, an intrepid adventurer on a relentless mission to stay alive amidst the ruins of a ravaged city. Navigate through the desolate streets and dank sewers, overrun by a relentless horde of zombies.
